name: FoxLab
description:
[font=res://resources/fonts/actual/base/font_22.tres][color=#fdba74]狐狸实验室 · FoxLab[/color][/font]
疯狂的土豆机制合集。
• 新增 53 位[color=#6ee7a8]角色[/color]、18 件可掉落[color=#fdba74]道具[/color]，以及通缉令等[color=#d8b4fe]特殊道具[/color]。
• 特色机制：[color=#67e8f9]属性数值移动[/color]、[color=#93c5fd]觉醒技能[/color]、[color=#fde047]敌人伪装[/color]、[color=#fca5a5]复合武器[/color]、[color=#d8b4fe]敌人种子[/color]、[color=#6ee7a8]变身面具[/color]、[color=#c4b5fd]敌人蜕变[/color]等等。
A collection of crazy potato mechanics.
• Adds 53 [color=#6ee7a8]characters[/color] and 18 droppable [color=#fdba74]items[/color], plus [color=#d8b4fe]special items[/color] such as wanted notices.
• New mechanics: [color=#67e8f9]stat digit movement[/color], [color=#93c5fd]awakened skills[/color], [color=#fde047]enemy disguises[/color], [color=#fca5a5]hybrid weapons[/color], [color=#d8b4fe]enemy seeds[/color], [color=#6ee7a8]transformation masks[/color], [color=#c4b5fd]enemy metamorphosis[/color] and more.
